data.one_liner: Dart implementation of AWS Signature Version 4 for signing HTTP requests.
data.what_it_does: Provides a signer that creates AWS Signature V4 signed HTTP requests using supplied credentials. Works across web, VM, and Flutter platforms and supports wasm. The signed request can then be sent with any HTTP client.
use_when: You need to call AWS services directly from Dart/Flutter without using a higher‑level SDK
You require custom request signing for AWS services on web, mobile, or desktop
avoid_when: You already use a full AWS SDK that handles signing internally
You need a complete client library for a specific AWS service
weaknesses: Only handles signing, you must manage HTTP transport yourself
Limited to AWS services; not a general purpose HTTP client
